title: Ligita, Liechtenstein Guitar Days
description:
From July 4th to 11th, ligita concerts, master classes and a guitar exhibition will take place on the occasion of the 33rd Liechtenstein Guitar Days.  
As part of this concert series, TrioConBrio's chamber concert will be performed in the Gampriner Saal on July 5th.
Master concerts of the ligita 2026

SA, July 4th: David Russell (7:30 p.m., Eschen Community Hall)
SUN, July 5th: Chamber concert with TrioConBrio with cello & duo Augustin Wiedemann and José María Gallardo del Rey (7 p.m., Gamprin community hall)
MON, July 6th: Alvaro Pierri (8 p.m., Ruggell Community Hall)
Tuesday, July 7th: Studio Live Session with Thanos Mitsalas and Duo StriAgo (8 p.m., Little Big Beat Studios)
FRI, July 10th: Duo Zoran Dukic and Aniello Desiderio (8 p.m., Mauren Parish Church)
SA, July 11th: Yamandu Costa (7 p.m., Eschen community hall)

Other concerts (free entry – collection)

MO, July 6th: Kevelaer Quartet (6 p.m., Ruggell Community Hall)
MO, July 6th: Hauser Trio (10 p.m., Landgasthof Rössle Ruggell)
Thursday, July 9th: Concert by the ligita participants (8 p.m., Schellenberg parish church)

 13th international ligita competition
After an online preliminary round, the best young guitarists play in the second and third round in front of the jury and the audience.

Thursday, July 9th, 9:30 a.m.: Semifinals in the Eschen Music School Center (free entry – collection)
SA, July 11th, 2 p.m.: Finale in the Eschen Music School Center (free entry - collection)

Interested in guitar music? Buy your tickets in advance: post offices in Eschen, Schaan and Vaduz or at starticket.ch
Further information: www.ligita.li​​​​​​​

title: Fitness/outdoor training
description: You will need your own mat for your training. If you want, you can also bring a drinking bottle with you - we hope you have a lot of fun during your training.

title: Queer picnic
description:
Whether alone, with friends or family - everyone wants to come, celebrate diversity and experience community.
Feel free to bring something to eat with you or pick up something tasty on site. Come by, bring your picnic blanket and let's spend a colorful summer day together!
Further information at www.flay.lgbt

title: Brain fitness training
description:
Course leader:
Elke Nestler-Schreiber, synapse coach, brain fitness trainer
Cost per person:
CHF 17.-- per hour for pensioners in the communities of Gamprin, Ruggell and Schellenberg. The course is financially supported by the three communities.
Registration and information:
Directly from the course leader, Tel. +41 79 450 21 92 or info(at)denkduenger.li. Trial lessons or entry is possible at any time. No previous knowledge is necessary. www.denkduenger.li.

title: Night clearing
description:
Together we make the Alps fit for summer: we collect stones and rubbish and mow weeds so that the cattle have well-tended pastures. Afterwards, a cozy end with fine food.
Departure (coach): 7:30 a.m. from the Gamprin clubhouse (with coffee stop)
Return journey:                  5:00 p.m. (arrival Gamprin approx. 6:00 p.m.)
What to bring:               Good shoes and clothing, gloves
Join us and register by Thursday, July 2, 2026:
info(at)gamprin.li or +423 375 91 00
Only takes place in dry weather. Information from 6:00 a.m. at:
Alpmeister Georg Oehri (+41 78 604 86 25)
Head Johannes Hasler (+423 375 91 02)
